## Description and Rationale

Software developer and founder of ibuildbots.dev, an independent verification service for AI agents. Coming to aviation data from outside the domain and treating taxi-out prediction as a rigorous, reproducible ML problem — physical drivers first, pre-registered validation, and a full log of experiments including the null results. Code will be published under GPLv3 with documentation sufficient to reproduce the results.
